_comment: Powered-staff base max hits by weapon-name substring (DpsCalculator.magicMaxHit): 'offset' adds to trunc(magic/3), floored at 1; 'fixed' is a flat base. The warped sceptre and bone staff keep their own formulas in code. Sanguinesti is trunc(magic/3) exactly (official-verified 2026-08-22).
